pairs.subject: dependency-declaration
pairs.evidence: features/lawwatch/getDependencyData.ts:43 The loader's requirement on its two payload files exists only as cwd-relative runtime path strings the packager cannot see, while the app-level .dockerignore:16-17 excludes `docs` as 'not needed at runtime', so by configuration the container image ships without them and the /zakony dependency section has no data.

techniques.evidence: features/lawwatch/getDependencyData.ts:44 Locality fails for file requirements: the unit cannot state them in any form the build reads, so inclusion depends on host-level documents it does not own (.dockerignore, next.config.ts, which has no outputFileTracingIncludes). Its module imports do satisfy locality, for example sectorAttribution.ts:18.

features/lawwatch/radarFeedCodecs.ts:18 Cross-unit references use the root alias and sibling references use relative paths (line 19); the target is a named module with no barrel to bypass. Applies to module references only; the payload path is scored under declaration-invariants.
features/lawwatch/getRadarData.ts:16 Static imports in a closed graph authored by one team, which is the technique's own stated exclusion; no resolve-on-traversal machinery is designed here.

features/lawwatch/deriveRadar.ts:19 The derivation is a plain module that the loader, feed routes, client and tests all call, so the capability is not bound to the server-only loader. buildDependencyView.ts has the same split.
features/lawwatch/deriveRadar.ts:37 The first-dependency cost is a whole-project property; this context only consumes the mechanism, and adds a dependency with one import line.

features/lawwatch/deriveRadar.ts:29 A private formatter copy was removed in favour of the shared one. escapeXml and rfc822 are copied across three feed codecs (radarFeedCodecs.ts:48 and :59), but they are small, stateless and stable, which the technique exempts.

features/lawwatch/radarFeedCodecs.ts:104 A foreign shape is filled by plain value construction. A search of the context's non-test source files for declare module, declare global, .prototype., Object.defineProperty and globalThis. found nothing, and the application is closed.
package.json:61 Third-party dependencies of this context use ordinary declared ranges; no conflict or resolution bypass was found (see notes).

pairs.registryProposal: declaration-invariants could name the non-code form of the locality failure: a requirement expressed only as a runtime path string is invisible to the packager, so an exclusion list can remove it without any declaration disagreeing. The golden path mentions a component naming its assets, but no technique gives a test for this.
